# Christina's Cleaning Services

> Licensed and insured residential and commercial cleaning company serving Lewes, Rehoboth Beach, Millsboro and Sussex County, Delaware. Phone: (443) 210-6133. Email: christinascleaningservices4@gmail.com. Free, no-obligation estimates.

## Services
- [Residential cleaning](https://christinascleaningservices.com/services/residential-cleaning/): weekly, bi-weekly, monthly and one-time house cleaning
- [Deep cleaning](https://christinascleaningservices.com/services/deep-cleaning/): grout, baseboards, window tracks, vents and hard-to-reach areas
- [Commercial cleaning](https://christinascleaningservices.com/services/commercial-cleaning/): offices, pharmacies and retail, on daily, weekly or custom schedules
- [Move in / move out cleaning](https://christinascleaningservices.com/services/move-in-move-out-cleaning/)
- [Post-construction cleaning](https://christinascleaningservices.com/services/post-construction-cleaning/)
